name: tower
description: AIエージェント管制塔 — 複数プロジェクト×複数エージェントを一画面で指揮する

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/user-agent
scripts.desktop: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run start -w apps/desktop
